subject: Assignment
finding: Judge Story is the presiding district judge in 2:26-cv-00110, and Magistrate Judge Anna W. Howard is the referred magistrate
verification_method: CourtListener RECAP docket 73194013 fields assigned_to_str and referred_to_str
what_it_supports: The bench for this matter, and the caption suffix RWS-AWH
what_it_does_not_establish: Nothing about how either will rule
notes: This also verifies that the case number in SRC-032 and SRC-033 - '2:26-cv-00110-SCJ-AWH', implying Judge Steve C. Jones - is WRONG. See CON-010.

subject: Docket depth
finding: Judge Story has at least 117 RECAP dockets in N.D. Ga. matching wrongful foreclosure and security deed terms, running from 2010 to the present
verification_method: CourtListener RECAP docket search, assigned_to Story, court gand
what_it_supports: That he has seen this kind of case many times and will not need the doctrine explained
what_it_does_not_establish: Any outcome distribution - RECAP holds only what somebody purchased, so this is a floor, not a census
notes: Practical consequence: a brief that spends its length restating settled Georgia foreclosure law spends it badly. The distinguishing facts are what will carry.

subject: Disposition speed
finding: In the twenty most relevant dockets returned, every one carries a termination date, with most terminating between roughly four and eighteen months after filing
verification_method: CourtListener RECAP, same search, dateFiled and dateTerminated fields read on twenty dockets
what_it_supports: That mortgage cases before this judge resolve rather than linger, usually on the pleadings
what_it_does_not_establish: A rate, a median, or an outcome. Twenty of at least 117 is a sample chosen by relevance ranking, not at random, and termination says nothing about who won
notes: Stated because the shape matters for sequencing, and stated with its limits because a ranked sample is not a statistic. Do not put a percentage in a filing on this basis.

subject: This matter
finding: On 2026-07-20 Judge Story denied remand, denied the preliminary injunction and oral-hearing motions as moot, ordered at least 60 days advance notice before any foreclosure, and referred the motions to dismiss to the magistrate under Standing Order 18-01
what_it_supports: That the court has already engaged with the merits of the posture and imposed a protective condition of its own motion
what_it_does_not_establish: That the court has any view on the substantive claims
notes: The 60-day notice condition was not requested in those terms. A court that imposes a protective condition sua sponte is not hostile to the plaintiffs' position on foreclosure risk.

subject: Role
finding: Magistrate Judge Howard is the standing referral magistrate for matters assigned to Judge Story in the Gainesville Division, and carries at least 699 N.D. Ga. referrals
verification_method: CourtListener RECAP, referred_to Howard, court gand
what_it_supports: That she will handle the pleading-stage disposition here, and that the referral is routine rather than case-specific
what_it_does_not_establish: Her reasoning, her published views, or her disposition rate
notes: Every 2:26-cv docket assigned to Story in the returned set is referred to Howard. Her referral docket also carries a heavy volume of consumer-reporting cases (Equifax, Experian, Trans Union) - a docket in which a well-organised FCRA-adjacent pleading is familiar territory.

subject: Published record
finding: No published opinion authored by Magistrate Judge Howard could be located
verification_method: CourtListener opinion search on judge Howard and on her full name, court gand - both returned zero
what_it_supports: That her reasoning cannot be predicted from published opinions, and that anyone claiming to know her tendencies from case law is not working from the record
what_it_does_not_establish: That she has no written record - magistrate reports and recommendations are frequently unpublished and live only on the docket
notes: Doc. 35 is therefore the single most important source on how she reasons, and it is in hand. Read it as the specification it is, not as background.

subject: This matter
finding: On 2026-07-31 she held the complaint to be a type-one shotgun pleading, directed an amended complaint by 2026-08-21, denied Docs. 4 and 5 as moot with leave to renew, gave Defendants 14 days from filing to respond, and cautioned that dismissal could follow
what_it_supports: Exactly what she requires, in her own words
what_it_does_not_establish: That she will dismiss if the requirement is met
notes: Paired with Vibe Micro at 1309 - 'specific instructions on how to properly do so. He did not fix it.' - compliance with Doc. 35's own terms is the dispositive procedural fact in this matter.

subject: Caudell comparison
finding: The posture in Caudell v. NewRez - an initial motion to dismiss resolved at Doc. 11, a repleading, then a second motion granted only in part at Doc. 17 - is structurally the same posture this matter now occupies
what_it_supports: That a repleading followed by a partially successful motion is a realistic and recently observed outcome in a NewRez/Shellpoint case in this circuit
what_it_does_not_establish: That the same result follows here - different district, different judge, different pleading
notes: Caudell is M.D. Ga. before Judge Self, not N.D. Ga. It is persuasive framing for a client conversation about realistic outcomes, not authority.
